name: Jemeti
description:
## About Jemeti

Jemeti helps workshop and maintenance shop owners schedule jobs, track parts, and manage customer vehicles — all from one place.

### Built for Service Shops

From oil changes to full rebuilds, Jemeti keeps work orders, technician assignments, and parts inventory organised.

### Coming Soon

We're building Jemeti with real shop owners. Get in touch if you'd like early access.
